explanation: Predictions or revelations about future events, often given by God through a prophet.
A supernatural experience where a person sees images or scenes, often with symbolic meaning.
Symbols for various kingdoms and nations described in Daniel's visions. Each beast represents a specific kingdom.
The first beast in Daniel's vision, symbolizing the Babylonian empire.
The second beast, representing the Medo-Persian empire.
The third beast, standing for the Greek empire under Alexander the Great.
A terrifying and powerful beast that represents the Roman empire.
Part of the fourth beast, symbolizing ten kings or kingdoms that will arise from the Roman empire.
An eleventh horn that appears among the ten, representing an evil power or antichrist.
A title for God, describing his eternal existence and authority.
A messianic figure who comes on the clouds and receives an everlasting kingdom from the Ancient of Days.
A time when God will judge the nations and humanity, and establish his eternal kingdom.
